# . (git-lanes)

Root package configuration via `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `bunfig.toml` defines `git-lanes` CLI entry `./bin/git-lanes`, TypeScript `ESNext` compilation, and Bun test timeouts `30000`. Documentation suite `README.md`, `ARCHITECTURE.md`, `SECURITY.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md` specifies session lifecycle, vulnerability reporting, and `spawnSync` enforcement.

## Stack

Runtime requires Bun `>=1.0.0`, Git `2.20+`, optional `gh` CLI for `src/forge/github.ts`. Package type `module` enables ESM imports in `src/cli.ts`. TypeScript `^5` peer dependency enforced via `tsconfig.json` `strict: true` flags.

## Configuration

`.lanes.json` schema in repository root defines `shared_dirs` (string[]), `main_branch_policy` (`block`|`allow`|`prompt`), `force_cleanup` (`force`|`fail`|`prompt`), `adopt_changes` (`always`|`never`|`prompt`), `branch_prefix` (string, default `lanes/`). `package.json` `scripts` object maps `dev` to `src/cli.ts`, `build` to `dist/`, `test` to `test/` suites. `tsconfig.json` `compilerOptions` enable `verbatimModuleSyntax`, `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, `noImplicitOverride`.

## Behavioral Contracts

Session validation enforces `SESSION_NAME_REGEX=/^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._-]*$/` via `validateSessionName()`. Dangerous characters `;&|` `` ` `` `$(){}[]!#~'"\\<>` rejected by `DANGEROUS_CHARS` pattern in `SECURITY.md`. Path traversal protection blocks `..`, `/`, `\` in session names. File locking uses `LOCK_STALE_MS = 30_000` threshold in `isLockStale()`. Git execution mandates `spawnSync` with array arguments in `git.ts` — never `execSync` with strings. Manifest writes use temp file + `renameSync` for atomicity in `saveManifest()`. Merge conflict detection checks `git merge-tree` stdout for verbatim `<<<<<<<` pattern. Default branch fallback checks `origin/HEAD` symbolic-ref, falls back to `main`/`master`.

## Workflow & Conventions

Test suites `test/unit`, `test/integration`, `test/security`, `test/e2e`, `test/stress` execute via `bun test` before PR submission. Commits require `feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `test:`, `chore:` prefixes per `CONTRIBUTING.md`. PR descriptions must note if AI coding tools assisted development. `dependabot.yml` sets `open-pull-requests-limit` to 5 per ecosystem. `CODEOWNERS` matches `*` glob pattern to `@bugracakmak` reviewer. `publish.yml` triggers on `v*` tags requiring `secrets.NPM_TOKEN`. `ci.yml` runs matrix strategy on `ubuntu-latest`/`macos-latest` with `bun-version: latest`.
